name: Qdrant
one_liner: Vector similarity search engine and database, written in Rust.
what_it_is: A vector similarity search engine and vector database, in its own words, written in Rust and tailored for extended filtering support — useful where matching is semantic but the result still has to satisfy structured conditions.
why_it_matters: Filtering is where naive vector search usually fails in production: the nearest neighbours are right but half of them are for the wrong tenant, the wrong date or the wrong permission. Treating filters as part of the search rather than a post-processing step is the difference between correct results and plausible ones.
suitable_for: Search where structured filters must apply alongside similarity
Multi-tenant retrieval where isolation is a correctness requirement
Workloads that outgrew similarity search inside the primary database
not_suitable_for: Small corpora where an extension to an existing database serves
Teams unwilling to operate another stateful service
Cases where filtering alone answers the question and no embedding is needed
